record.paper_title: Operations Research challenges in forestry: 33 open problems
record.original_question: Real-time dispatching of logging trucks must react continuously to events such as queues, bad weather, and truck breakdowns while trucks, loaders, and decision centers exchange live information. The open question is how to develop forestry VRP models and algorithms for real-time planning that explicitly incorporate changing conditions and queuing at loading and unloading points.

evidence.quote: Open Problem 8 How can we develop models and methods of the forestry VRP dealing with real-time planning including queuing at loading and unloading points?

artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has addressed parts of the problem—e.g., Amrouss et al. (2017) developed real-time methods for managing transportation disruptions in forestry, and several recent papers model simultaneous routing and scheduling of logging trucks with synchronization at loaders to reduce waiting times. However, a comprehensive forestry VRP framework that jointly handles real-time re-planning, queueing at loading/unloading points, and dynamic events such as weather and breakdowns remains an active research area without a definitive solution.

status_evidence.title: Real-time management of transportation disruptions in forestry
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses real-time rescheduling of logging truck operations in response to disruptions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on real-time forestry VRP under disruptions.

status_evidence.title: A mathematical modeling for simultaneous routing and scheduling of logging trucks in the forest supply chain
status_evidence.snippet: Models routing and scheduling of logging trucks accounting for synchronization at loading points.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work tackles scheduling and queue-related synchronization, but not full real-time stochastic setting.

status_evidence.title: Transportation and routing in forestry logistics
status_evidence.snippet: Notes that queuing at loaders and unloading sites is a major operational concern and is handled with various model variants.
status_evidence.claim: Queuing at loaders remains a recognized open operational challenge in forestry VRP.
